findings.statement: CA9 is strongly up in tumours at RNA [gene=CA9; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-RNA; layer=rna; log2fc=6.312] and protein [gene=CA9; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=2.269], replicates in TCGA-KIRC and survives purity extrapolation, so it is a top tissue biomarker; however GTEx vital-organ proteome shows stomach enrichment, an on-target off-tumour caution [gene=CA9; type=normal_proteome; source=DATASET:GTEX-PROTEOME; vital_protein_ts_max=5.19].

CD70 is up at RNA [gene=CD70; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-RNA; layer=rna; log2fc=4.464] and protein [gene=CD70; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=2.421], replicates in TCGA-KIRC and is not tissue-enriched in vital organs, which favours a surface antigen target (antibody or cell therapy) [gene=CD70; type=normal_proteome; source=DATASET:GTEX-PROTEOME; vital_protein_ts_max=0.34].

NNMT has the highest protein induction among top candidates [gene=NNMT; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=2.709], replicates in TCGA-KIRC and higher expression is associated with worse overall survival [gene=NNMT; type=tcga_survival; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; log_hr_per_sd=0.301]; it is an intracellular metabolic enzyme, so a small-molecule rather than antibody target and a prognostic biomarker.

ENPP3 is a membrane ectoenzyme up at protein [gene=ENPP3; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=1.544] and RNA [gene=ENPP3; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-RNA; layer=rna; log2fc=3.895], replicated in TCGA-KIRC, with an antibody-drug conjugate (AGS-16C3F) already tested, making it a tractable surface target.

SLC16A3 (MCT4 lactate exporter, a plasma-membrane transporter) is up at protein [gene=SLC16A3; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=2.279] and RNA [gene=SLC16A3; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-RNA; layer=rna; log2fc=3.435], with a purity-robust tumour-intrinsic signal and TCGA replication; it fits the glycolytic, HIF-driven phenotype.

SCARB1 (HDL receptor, cholesterol uptake) tops the target profile ranking: up at RNA [gene=SCARB1; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-RNA; layer=rna; log2fc=2.974] and protein [gene=SCARB1; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=1.837], with strong TCGA replication and no prognostic signal; its link to lipid-laden clear-cell biology is plausible but it is also expressed in normal liver and adrenal.

HK2 is up at protein [gene=HK2; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=2.106] and RNA [gene=HK2; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-RNA; layer=rna; log2fc=3.351], concordant across layers and replicated in TCGA-KIRC, supporting the Warburg-type metabolic reprogramming of ccRCC.

ANGPTL4, a secreted HIF target, is up at RNA [gene=ANGPTL4; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-RNA; layer=rna; log2fc=5.567] and protein [gene=ANGPTL4; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=1.73], a candidate circulating or tissue biomarker of the VHL-HIF axis.

PSAT1 is the top-ranked biomarker and is down in tumours at protein [gene=PSAT1; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=-1.963] and RNA [gene=PSAT1; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-RNA; layer=rna; log2fc=-3.867], replicated in TCGA-KIRC and prognostic there; as a down-regulated gene it is a biomarker, not a target.

ALDH6A1 is lost in tumours at protein [gene=ALDH6A1; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=-1.925], sits on 14q with frequent copy-number loss [gene=ALDH6A1; type=omics_cnv; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-CNV; arm=14q; loss_freq=0.355], and higher expression in TCGA-KIRC predicts better survival [gene=ALDH6A1; type=tcga_survival; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; log_hr_per_sd=-0.554]; a loss-of-identity prognostic biomarker.

PCK1 reflects loss of proximal tubule gluconeogenic identity: down at protein [gene=PCK1; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=-1.859] and RNA [gene=PCK1; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-RNA; layer=rna; log2fc=-4.424], replicated and prognostic in TCGA-KIRC (better survival with higher expression).

caveats: Bulk tumour-vs-normal comparisons; normal kidney tissue differs in cell composition from tumour, so purity checks were taken from the ranking components rather than rerun per gene.
GTEx vital-organ proteome has no kidney and limited detection, so absence of enrichment is not proof of safety (checked only for CA9 and CD70).
PRISM drug response, mutation recurrence, cis copy number and kinase activity were not queried for these candidates; 2D cell lines miss HIF-2 biology.

Statements about drug tractability (e.g. AGS-16C3F for ENPP3) come from convergence ranking drug annotations; biological roles of SCARB1, SLC16A3 and ANGPTL4 are background knowledge, not tool output.
ENPP3, SLC16A3, SCARB1, HK2, ANGPTL4 and PCK1 TCGA/purity statements rely on ranking-component records not individually re-queried.
